commands.#comment: THIS SCRIPT WORKS WITH MISSION VERSION EQUAL OR ABOVE TO THE FOLLOWING
BASIC USERS MUST USE ONLY 'EDITABLE AREA STARTS HERE' AREA--------------------------------------------
0) CREATE A UNIQUE id OF THE SCRIPT (AT BEGINNING OF FILE, REPLACE 'Prototype_1' WITH SOMETHING ELSE--
1) PUT MISSION ID (AS PER CUSTOM MISSION LIST) IN L:CUS_ID_CARD value---------------------------------
3) PUT SUBVARIANT (1 to 3, only effective on few accidents) IN L:CUS_MISSION_SCENE_VARIANT value------
NOTE: DISPATCH CODE DIGITS ARE AS FOLLOW: 1st:MISSION ID; 2nd:VARIANT; 3rd:SUBVARIANT (Step 1,2,3)----
4) PUT ACCIDENT LAT and LON (GOOGLE MAPS FORMAT) IN L:CUS_ACCIDENT LAT and L:CUS_ACCIDENT LON---------
5) PUT (OPTIONAL) STARTING LAT,LON (GOOGLE MAPS FORMAT) IN 'START' location at the top of file--------
6) SET (OPTIONAL) AMBULANCE/FIRE ENGINE TRUCK/POLICE PRESENCE AS FOLLOW:------------------------------
7) 0: VEHICLE NOT PRESENT; 1: VEHICLE ON SCENE; 2: VEHICLE ON THE ROAD--------------------------------
MISSION SELECTION
ACCIDENT LOCATION
RESCUE VEHICLE PRESENCE
1) L:SKIP_QUERY allows to skip the location query. Values: 0:Query is executed, 1:Query is skipped----
2) L:CUS_CARLS_AUTOCONNECT autoconnection of CARLS radio at mission start. 1:Enabled 0:Normal---------
3) L:SKIPIFCLOSE allows skipping menu if this script is executed with H/C close to starting point-----
1) local OBJECTx allows to add any object to the sim (name must be exactly the one in aircraft.cfg)---
4) Unused local OBJECTx must be set to value: null, or the relative fields deleted, to disable it/them
5) L:CUSVFXA allows VFX (smoke/fire) to be moved out from default position if needed -----------------
NOTE:OBJETC1, 10, 15 will point towards accident location --------------------------------------------
OTHER OBJECTS (START WITH OBJECT1 AND UP TO OBJECT15) NO MORE THAN 15 OBJECTS ALLOWED ----------------
OBJECTS LVARS ARE ACTUALLY NOT SUPPORTED (THEY WILL BE SET TO 0) -------------------------------------
VFX RELOCATION (IF VFX IS PRESENT). Keep it 0 to avoid relocation ------------------------------------
FOR SUPER ADVANCED USERS: You may go to 'data' section and customize the custom mission (ID 999)------
